description: This file contains a class 'KubernetesHostingOptionsValidator' which implements options validation for 'KubernetesHostingOptions' in the Orleans.Hosting.Kubernetes namespace. It checks for required properties 'Namespace' and 'PodName' and generates failure messages if they are not set.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingOptionsValidator
classes.description: Implements validation logic for Kubernetes hosting options within Orleans.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates 'KubernetesHostingOptions' instance, ensuring 'Namespace' and 'PodName' are set, returning appropriate validation result.
